process_area.title: Legal Matter, Case & Outside Counsel Management

value_stream.name: Legal Operations, Litigation & Intellectual Property Management

fields.Participants: Legal Ops Mgr, VP Legal & Compliance, In-House Counsel, Business Owner, Records (links to VS-88)
fields.Trigger: Demand letter / summons received; dispute escalated by business unit; regulatory inquiry

workflows.name: Legal Matter Intake, Triage & Matter Master

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Legal Ops Mgr logs the intake of the matter" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "VP Legal & Compliance/In-House Counsel triage" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-run of "conflicts check (W3275)" against the matter register (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-529 (ensure controlled execution — Legal Matter, Case & Outside Counsel Management (PA-100.1).)
- operational: docket/calendar discipline and triage SLA; operational: conflicts check (W3275)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Missed-deadline risk**: Failure to answer/appear → default judgment; mitigated by docket/calendar discipline and triage SLA
- **Conflicts risk**: Undetected conflict of interest with BuildRight/counterparty; mitigated by conflicts check (W3275)
System Touchpoints: - Legal matter-management/e-billing (W3279); records (links to VS-88); risk register (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Legal Ops Mgr logs the intake of the matter: capture source (summons, demand letter, business escalation, regulatory notice — links to VS-22), parties, subject matter, jurisdiction/venue, amount in controversy, key dates (answer deadline, hearing), originating business unit and documents; create unique matter ID in legal matter-management system

VP Legal & Compliance/In-House Counsel triage: assess merits, exposure, urgency, and complexity; assign handling (in-house vs outside counsel W3259), strategy (defend/settle/counterclaim/ADR W3260), and resourcing; classify by matter type (commercial, labor per VS-84, consumer/DTI per VS-13, property per VS-97, tax per VS-79, IP per PA-100.2); set reserves (W3261)

Open matter file and notify stakeholders: matter master (parties, counsel, dates, status, exposure, reserve), conflicts check (VS-100.3/W3275 conflict-of-interest also links to VS-86.3), litigation hold if applicable (W3262), business-owner briefing and document-collection request; integrate to risk register (links to VS-21.2)

fields.Participants: Litigation Counsel, VP Legal & Compliance, Outside Counsel (W3259), Business Owner, Records (links to VS-88)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "track all filings and court dates in docket" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "records" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "update matter status, reserve, and stakeholders" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-529 (ensure controlled execution — Legal Matter, Case & Outside Counsel Management (PA-100.1).)
- operational: early merits assessment and settlement discipline (W3261); operational: hold (W3262) and records coordination (links to VS-88)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Adverse-judgment risk**: Loss at trial with damages and costs; mitigated by early merits assessment and settlement discipline (W3261)
- **Discovery-miss risk**: Failure to produce leads to sanctions/adverse inference; mitigated by hold (W3262) and records coordination (links to VS-88)
System Touchpoints: - Matter/docket management (W3279); records/e-discovery (links to VS-88); risk register (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Manage answer/response and pleadings: prepare and file answer/counterclaim/third-party complaint within deadline, motions to dismiss, motions for bill of particulars; coordinate with business owner on facts and defenses; track all filings and court dates in docket

Manage discovery: written discovery (requests for admission, interrogatories, requests for documents), depositions, pre-trial conference and pre-trial order; coordinate evidence and witnesses (W3262), e-discovery with records (links to VS-88 W2990); manage privilege review and protective orders

Trial preparation and conduct: trial strategy, witness preparation, exhibit management, trial brief; attend hearings/trial; manage settlement opportunities throughout (W3261); update matter status, reserve, and stakeholders

fields.Participants: Legal Ops Mgr, VP Legal & Compliance, Procurement (links to VS-34), Finance, Outside Counsel
fields.Trigger: Matter requires external counsel (complexity, capacity, specialized expertise, jurisdiction)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "VP Legal & Compliance/Procurement" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document-handling/privilege, billing guidelines, termination" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "review and approve invoices against engagement terms and budget" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-529 (ensure controlled execution — Legal Matter, Case & Outside Counsel Management (PA-100.1).)
- operational: budgets, billing guidelines, and e-billing controls; operational: panel management and performance review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-overrun risk**: Outside-counsel spend exceeds budget; mitigated by budgets, billing guidelines, and e-billing controls
- **Quality/fit risk**: Poor counsel performance harms outcomes; mitigated by panel management and performance review
System Touchpoints: - e-Billing/matter management (W3279); procurement (links to VS-34); finance/AP (links to VS-15); conflicts (W3275)

steps.activity: VP Legal & Compliance/Procurement (links to VS-34) select outside counsel: identify qualified firms (expertise, jurisdiction, track record), run conflicts check (W3275), request fee proposals; evaluate on expertise, cost, and fit; select per authority matrix; consider panel/preferred-firm strategy for recurring matter types
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / Procurement / Legal Ops Mgr

steps.activity: Legal/Finance negotiate engagement letter: scope, fee structure (hourly with rate caps, fixed/flat fee, contingency, blended), budget, staffing, conflict and ethical walls, document-handling/privilege, billing guidelines, termination; execute engagement letter and matter budget

Manage outside counsel performance and billing: review and approve invoices against engagement terms and budget (e-billing W3279), challenge excessive/unsupported entries, track spend vs budget and estimate-to-complete, manage counsel performance (responsiveness, quality); periodic review of panel

fields.Participants: Litigation Counsel, VP Legal & Compliance, Business Owner, Mediator/Arbitrator, Counterparty
fields.Trigger: ADR clause in contract; strategic settlement opportunity; court-annexed mediation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document proceedings and outcomes under privilege" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "records" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-529 (ensure controlled execution — Legal Matter, Case & Outside Counsel Management (PA-100.1).)
- operational: realistic assessment and settlement discipline; operational: sound procedure and enforcement (W3263)
Pain Points / Risks: - **ADR-failure risk**: Failed ADR wastes time/cost; mitigated by realistic assessment and settlement discipline
- **Enforceability risk**: Arbitral award challenge/delay; mitigated by sound procedure and enforcement (W3263)
System Touchpoints: - Matter management (W3279); settlement accounting (W3261); records (links to VS-88); contracts (W3273)

steps.activity: Assess ADR suitability: evaluate contractual ADR clauses (arbitration — CIAC for construction, commercial arbitration per the Arbitration Law (RA 876) and the ADR Act (RA 9285); mediation), cost/time/precedence vs litigation, confidentiality benefit, relationship preservation; recommend ADR where advantageous

Conduct ADR: select mediator/arbitrator and institution, prepare position and settlement range (W3261), attend sessions, negotiate; for arbitration, present case and manage award; document proceedings and outcomes under privilege
steps.r: Litigation Counsel / Outside Counsel / Business Owner

steps.activity: Conclude: execute settlement agreement (W3261) or manage arbitral award (confirmation/vacatur/enforcement per W3263); close matter and update records; capture lessons and update contract templates (W3273) and dispute strategy

fields.Participants: VP Legal & Compliance, Finance (links to VS-17), Litigation Counsel, Tax (links to VS-79), Treasury (links to VS-18)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "analyze appeal prospects" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-update of "update reserve as facts develop" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "Execute and account" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-154 (ensure legal matter & IP portfolio control.)
- operational: PAS 37 (IAS 37) discipline and legal-finance coordination; operational: merits assessment and authority discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-accrual risk**: Inadequate reserve distorts financials and surprises audit; mitigated by PAS 37 (IAS 37) discipline and legal-finance coordination
- **Over-settlement risk**: Settling unmeritorious claims invites more claims; mitigated by merits assessment and authority discipline
System Touchpoints: - Matter/claim accounting (links to VS-17); treasury/payment (links to VS-18); tax (links to VS-79); audit (links to VS-22.2)

steps.activity: Establish settlement authority and range: VP Legal & Compliance and Finance assess exposure, probable outcome, settlement value vs litigation cost/risk; obtain settlement authority per authority matrix (links to VS-36); negotiate within authority; for judgments, analyze appeal prospects
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / Finance / Litigation Counsel

steps.activity: Finance assess and accrue loss contingency per PFRS/IAS 37: probable outflow and reliable estimate → accrue and disclose; possible → disclose only; remote → no action; update reserve as facts develop; coordinate with audit (links to VS-22.2) and consolidation (links to VS-17.2)

Execute and account: settlement agreement and release, payment (links to VS-15/VS-18), tax treatment (deductibility, DST on settlement documents, links to VS-79), derecognize reserve and book gain/loss on settlement; close matter (W3257) and update analytics (W3264)

fields.Participants: Litigation Counsel, Legal Ops Mgr, Records (links to VS-88), IT (links to VS-27/VS-99), Business Owners, Custodians
fields.Trigger: Reasonable anticipation of litigation (W3257); regulatory investigation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records, CCTV per VS-23.2, POS/WMS data" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Coordinate evidence collection and preservation" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System continuous audit of "Release hold at matter close" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-529 (ensure controlled execution — Legal Matter, Case & Outside Counsel Management (PA-100.1).)
- operational: timely hold and preservation; operational: scoped holds and custodian discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Spoliation risk**: Destroyed/altered evidence triggers adverse inference and sanctions; mitigated by timely hold and preservation
- **Over-collection cost**: Over-broad holds inflate e-discovery cost; mitigated by scoped holds and custodian discipline
System Touchpoints: - Legal hold/records (links to VS-88); e-discovery (links to VS-88 W2990); IT/evidence (links to VS-27/VS-99); CCTV (links to VS-23.2)

steps.activity: Litigation Counsel issue litigation hold notice: identify custodians and data sources (email, files, ERP records, CCTV per VS-23.2, POS/WMS data), suspend retention/deletion for hold scope (executed by VS-88 W2990 legal-hold), notify custodians of preservation obligation and consequences of spoliation

Coordinate evidence collection and preservation: collect and preserve relevant documents/data (chain of custody per VS-88 W2990), coordinate IT for electronic evidence (links to VS-27/VS-99), preserve CCTV/physical evidence within retention windows, manage privilege and protective orders

Release hold at matter close: when litigation/investigation concludes, issue hold-release to records (links to VS-88) to resume normal retention/deletion; document hold lifecycle for audit (links to VS-21/VS-22.2)

fields.Participants: Litigation Counsel, Legal Ops Mgr, Outside Counsel, Process Server, Sheriff
fields.Trigger: Pleadings/motions to file; judgment to enforce; service required
fields.Volume: Hundreds of filings/year across active cases

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "prepare and file pleadings/motions with the correct court" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "record judgment liens, pursue garnishment of bank accounts/receivables" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "counterparty appeals" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-529 (ensure controlled execution — Legal Matter, Case & Outside Counsel Management (PA-100.1).)
- operational: docket calendar and SLA; operational: pre-judgment attachment and asset discovery
Pain Points / Risks: - **Missed-filing-deadline risk**: Late filing → dismissal/adverse; mitigated by docket calendar and SLA
- **Enforcement-difficulty risk**: Uncollectible judgment despite favorable outcome; mitigated by pre-judgment attachment and asset discovery
System Touchpoints: - Matter/docket management (W3279); AP/docket fees (links to VS-15); collections (links to VS-16.2)

steps.activity: Manage court filings and service: prepare and file pleadings/motions with the correct court (RTC, MTC, MTCC, NLRC, CA, SC, quasi-judicial bodies), pay docket/filing fees (links to VS-15), serve process on parties per Rules of Court; track filings and service proofs
steps.r: Litigation Counsel / Outside Counsel / Process Server

steps.activity: Enforce favorable judgments: secure writ of execution, coordinate sheriff for levy/garnishment/attachment on counterparty assets, record judgment liens, pursue garnishment of bank accounts/receivables; manage post-judgment collection (links to VS-16.2)

Manage appeals: assess appeal prospects and deadlines (notice of appeal, record on appeal), brief and file appeal; manage counterparty appeals (supersedeas bond to stay execution); track through appellate levels

fields.Participants: Legal Ops Mgr, VP Legal & Compliance, Finance (links to VS-17), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Board (links to VS-36.1)
fields.Trigger: Quarterly legal review; period-end reserve cycle; board reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compile matter portfolio analytics" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile to financial statements and audit" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "Report to executive committee and board" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-529 (ensure controlled execution — Legal Matter, Case & Outside Counsel Management (PA-100.1).)
- operational: analytics and PAS 37 (IAS 37) discipline; operational: prevention analytics and contract/policy improvement
Pain Points / Risks: - **Forecast-blindness risk**: Inadequate loss forecasting surprises financials/audit; mitigated by analytics and PAS 37 (IAS 37) discipline
- **Trend-blindness risk**: Recurring matter types not addressed at root cause; mitigated by prevention analytics and contract/policy improvement
System Touchpoints: - Matter analytics/e-billing (W3279); finance/reserves (links to VS-17); risk register (links to VS-21.2); board reporting (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Legal Ops Mgr/Finance compile matter portfolio analytics: matters by type/stage/exposure/counsel, aging, reserve roll-forward, spend vs budget, win/loss/settlement outcomes, cycle time, outside-counsel spend

Finance/VP Legal & Compliance forecast legal loss: aggregate probable/possible exposures, model expected loss, set/adjust reserves (W3261), stress-test for tail risks; reconcile to financial statements and audit (links to VS-22.2/VS-17.2)

Report to executive committee and board (links to VS-36.1 litigation update): portfolio summary, key matters, trends, loss forecast, risk-register updates (links to VS-21.2), recommendations (prevention, contract improvement W3273, insurance coverage/recovery W59); drive preventive action
steps.r: VP Legal & Compliance / Legal Ops Mgr
